question: Simplify: (x + y)³ - (x - y)³ - 6y(x² - y²)
solution:
Given:

(x + y)3 - (x - y)3 - 6y(x2 - y2)

Formula Used:

(x+y)³ = x³ + y³ + 3x²y + 3xy²

(x-y)3 = x3 - y³ - 3x2y + 3xy2

Calculations:

The equations are 

⇒ (x + y)3 - (x - y)3 - 6y(x2 - y2)

now put the formula

⇒ x3 + y3 + 3x2y + 3xy² -(x3 - y3 - 3x2y + 3xy²) - 6y(x2 - y2)

⇒ x3 + y3 + 3x2y + 3xy2 - x3 + y3 + 3x2y - 3xy2) - 6yx2 + 6y³

Now the term which is opposite to each other, we get 

⇒ 8y³

⇒ **Hence, The value (x + y)3 - (x - y)3 - 6y(x2 - y2) is 8y³**
